who holds the keys in Aztec's selective disclosure comparison
summary_en: The ERC-4337 move to Final that yoavw submitted on May 26 was merged today, finalizing the contract level account abstraction standard. tcoratger, Justin Drake and others published a design space study for a validator post-quantum public key registry, the first step away from BLS signatures. Aztec pointed out that on several privacy networks control of selective disclosure sits with an operator.
